Method of Attack: SQL injection to gain access to Accellion File Transfer Appliance devices
Deployment of a web shell (DEWMODE) to extract file lists and metadata from MySQL database
Extortion campaign threatening to publish stolen data unless ransom is paid
Impacted Systems: Customers of Accellion FTA including Kroger, Singtel, QIMR Berghofer Medical Research Institute, Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC), Office of the Washington State Auditor (SAO), ABS Group, Jones Day, Danaher, Fugro, University of Colorado, American Bureau of Shipping (ABS)
Attack Vector: Multiple zero-day vulnerabilities including SQL injection (CVE-2021-27101), OS command execution (CVE-2021-27102, CVE-2021-27104), SSRF (CVE-2021-27103)
SQL injection via crafted Host header to deploy web shell
Indicators of Compromise: Emails threatening to publish stolen data on Clop ransomware leak site
IP address assigned to Fortunix Networks L.P. used to communicate with DEWMODE web shell
Use of multiple email accounts and SMTP infrastructure for extortion emails
Overlap with phishing IPs and email accounts used by FIN11
